sections.description_of_ingredients:
Vanga Bhasma: This is used in the treatment of digestive disorders, urinary disorders etc. This bhasma is prepared from Tin metal. It is also used in asthma, anemia diseases. 
 Abhrak Bhasma: This is prepared from Mica after the detoxification process. It is a classical Ayurvedic formulation used in managing reproductive, digestive, respiratory ailments. 
 Kanta Loha Bhasma: It is an Ayurvedic mineral based medicine prepared from iron oxide. It is used in the treatment of abdominal tumors and also used in anemia, jaundice, IBS etc. 
 Tamra Bhasma: It is used in the treatment of liver, spleen, stomach, intestines problems. It stimulates the secretion of bile from the liver. It eases digestion and appetite. 

 Method For The Preparation 

 Take all the ingredients in a kharal yantra and mixes them properly 
 Give Jambhiri swaras (Extracts of Citrus jambhiri ) to this mixture 
 Make 125 mg tablet and dry the under the shadow 
 Keep this formulation in a glass container 

 Medicinal Properties 
 Gulma Kuthar ras is an Ayurvedic formulation and used in the treatment of abdominal tumors. The ingredients are helpful in fighting against digestive ailments. It is also helpful in treating heart disorders. This gulma kuthar ras is very effective in indigestion, abdominal pain etc.

fullContent:
Gulmakuthar Ras 
 Reference – Bhaishajya-Ratnavali Gulmarogadhikar 658/111-112 
 Introduction 
 Gulma Kuthar ras is used in the treatment of abdominal diseases. It contains minerals as a main ingredient. 
 Ingredients 
 
 Vanga Bhasma (Tin calx) 
 Abhrak Bhasma (Mica calx) 
 Kanta Loha Bhasma (An iron compound) 
 Tamra Bhasma (Copper calx) 
 
 Description of Ingredients 
 
 Vanga Bhasma: This is used in the treatment of digestive disorders, urinary disorders etc. This bhasma is prepared from Tin metal. It is also used in asthma, anemia diseases. 
 Abhrak Bhasma: This is prepared from Mica after the detoxification process. It is a classical Ayurvedic formulation used in managing reproductive, digestive, respiratory ailments. 
 Kanta Loha Bhasma: It is an Ayurvedic mineral based medicine prepared from iron oxide. It is used in the treatment of abdominal tumors and also used in anemia, jaundice, IBS etc. 
 Tamra Bhasma: It is used in the treatment of liver, spleen, stomach, intestines problems. It stimulates the secretion of bile from the liver. It eases digestion and appetite. 
 
 Method For The Preparation 
 
 Take all the ingredients in a kharal yantra and mixes them properly 
 Give Jambhiri swaras (Extracts of Citrus jambhiri ) to this mixture 
 Make 125 mg tablet and dry the under the shadow 
 Keep this formulation in a glass container 
 
 Medicinal Properties 
 Gulma Kuthar ras is an Ayurvedic formulation and used in the treatment of abdominal tumors. The ingredients are helpful in fighting against digestive ailments. It is also helpful in treating heart disorders. This gulma kuthar ras is very effective in indigestion, abdominal pain etc. 
 Indications 
 
 Abdominal tumor 
 Indigestion 
 Abdominal pain 
 Heart problems 
 Bloating 
 
 Dosage 
 
 Mix this tablet with sajji kshar and yavakshar in 125 mg dose and give it with Adrak swaras (Extracts of Zingiber officinale) 
 
 Caution 
 
 Take under medical supervision 
 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
